_: In addition to the total shown, the WWII-era country Manchuku fielded an army of 200,000 and has since been absorbed into mainland China, forming the region Manchuria.
Data shown pertains to the USSR, which included not only modern Russia but also 14 additional modern countries (listed individually).

UK totals were originally credited specifically to Great Britain (England, Scotland, Wales). As such, it is unclear whether they include soldiers from Northern Ireland, Guernsey, Jersey, or Isle or Man.
